'''Chapter 59''' is titled "Obligation".

==Cover Page==
[[Buggy's Crew Adventure Chronicles]], Vol. 18: "Explosion!! Sleepwalking Richie".

Still dreaming of adventures as captain of his own crew, a sleepwalking [[Richie]] unknowingly knocks out [[Mohji]] and [[Cabaji]] both.

==Short Summary==
In order to save [[Sanji]]'s life, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] decides to destroy the [[Baratie]]. While they are arguing, [[Pearl]] attacks them but [[Gin]] knocks him out as he wants to kill Sanji himself.

==Long Summary==
[[Sanji]] continues to let [[Pearl]] assault him as he has decided to die rather than let the [[Baratie]] be taken by the [[Krieg Pirates]]. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] becomes angry as he does not understand how Sanji's death would repay [[Zeff]]'s sacrifice. To put an end to Sanji's suicide, he destroys the Baratie since it is the target of [[Krieg|Don Krieg]]. While Sanji and Luffy fighting about the best solution to save Zeff, Pearl decides to attack them. However, he is stopped by [[Gin]], who defeats him with one blow. He proclaims he will take care of Sanji's death, personally.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*Luffy destroys most of the [[Baratie]].
*[[Gin]] defeats [[Pearl]] so he can kill [[Sanji]].
